title: Best Soups for High Cholesterol (Heart-Healthy Recipes)
description: 73% of adults over 50 eat soup weekly—but not all soups help cholesterol. Learn which 5 heart-healthy soups lower LDL and how to avoid sodium traps.
reasoning: People are searching amid rising grocery prices and winter colds—looking for affordable, comforting, *and* cardiologist-approved meals. They’re confused by conflicting advice on canned vs. homemade, creamy vs. brothy, and sodium vs. saturated fat trade-offs—and want clear, practical guidance they can cook tonight.
